lab.purpose: Authorized local DNS lab for G0.4c: a lab zone served by an authoritative resolver plus a local passive-source stub, so Subfinder and DNSx runs are reproducible on this host without any internet or external target.

authorization.decision: Leader decision on item 51 (ultron-lead), 2026-11-24, under delegated owner authority: lab = local DNS lab only, in containers on this host; no external targets; third-party passive sources may be queried only for lab/authorized domains, and for the lab zone Subfinder talks to a local stub instead.
authorization.scope: Containers of compose project aegis-lab on this host; internal network aegis-lab-lab; documentation address ranges only. Nothing here resolves or contacts a real host, and no scanner runs against a non-lab target.
authorization.evidence: Linear item 51 comment of 2026-11-24; handoff to ultron-pi; report /orca/bots/ultron-lead/memory/reports/g0.4c.md

dns.role: authoritative DNS for the lab zone (lab infrastructure, not a capability provider)

passive.role: runs the local passive-source stub; same pin as deploy/dev/images.env AEGIS_PYTHON_IMAGE (bump both together)

dnsx.role: G0.2 pin; the only resolver client used by `make lab-dnsx`

subfinder.role: G0.2 pin; queries the local passive stub, never a third party

records.name: txt.lab.aegis.test.
records.value: aegis lab zone; not a real domain

probes.why: A record (MX is not queried by this run)
CNAME to www, resolved in the same answer
outside the lab zone: the resolver is not a forwarder

passive.note: The stub only answers the exact authorized query for the lab zone; it is reached through /etc/hosts inside the run container and a lab-only CA (generated by make lab-up, never committed).
